title: Twisted AlreadyCalled error spamming the log since update
body:
I have just updated my self hosted homeserver from 0.20.0 to 0.22.1. I have proceed as described in https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/blob/master/UPGRADE.rst, but maybe I have done something wrong. During the update, I had several Riot client connected, I don't know if this is related, but since, my homeserver.log keeps increasing, being spammed several times by second by the following error 

`
2017-07-26 16:29:42,216 - twisted - 131 - CRITICAL - - Unhandled Error
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "~/synapse/lib/python2.7/site-packages/synapse/app/homeserver.py", line 461, in in_thread
    reactor.run()
  File "~/synapse/lib/python2.7/site-packages/twisted/internet/base.py", line 1247, in run
    self.mainLoop()
  File "~/synapse/lib/python2.7/site-packages/twisted/internet/base.py", line 1256, in mainLoop
    self.runUntilCurrent()
  File "~/synapse/lib/python2.7/site-packages/synapse/metrics/__init__.py", line 151, in f
    ret = func(*args, **kwargs)
--- <exception caught here> ---
  File "~/synapse/lib/python2.7/site-packages/twisted/internet/base.py", line 882, in runUntilCurrent
    call.func(*call.args, **call.kw)
  File "~/synapse/lib/python2.7/site-packages/twisted/internet/tcp.py", line 292, in connectionLost
    protocol.connectionLost(reason)
  File "~/synapse/lib/python2.7/site-packages/twisted/protocols/tls.py", line 403, in connectionLost
    ProtocolWrapper.connectionLost(self, reason)
  File "~/synapse/lib/python2.7/site-packages/twisted/protocols/policies.py", line 125, in connectionLost
    self.wrappedProtocol.connectionLost(reason)
  File "~/synapse/lib/python2.7/site-packages/twisted/web/http.py", line 2190, in connectionLost
    self._abortingCall.cancel()
  File "~/synapse/lib/python2.7/site-packages/twisted/internet/base.py", line 101, in cancel
    raise error.AlreadyCalled
twisted.internet.error.AlreadyCalled: Tried to cancel an already-called event.
`

The log file size is really increasing, so I would like to get rid of this error. Everything seems to work fine, so I don't understand what the issue is... Any help would be really welcomed !
